line: When you think about funeral cover... who would you want on your plan?
At My Ekwee Growth, you can choose cover for yourself, or look at options for your family.
Family options can include a spouse, and up to six children. Selected plans also let you add parents, and extended family members.
Depending on your package, you can also access grocery and pharmacy coupons... plus a 24-hour helpline that can arrange assistance for home emergencies.
If you refer someone who joins, you may qualify for a referral reward. What you can earn depends on your membership level, and the programme rules.
Visit My Ekwee Growth online, to compare the plans, and see who you can cover.
